metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Apparel | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom recycled PET apparel for eco-friendly branding. Bulk orders available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET apparel is made from post-consumer plastic bottles, transformed into durable polyester fabric. This material offers the same performance as virgin polyester—moisture-wicking, quick-drying, and colorfast—while reducing landfill waste. For companies committed to sustainability, custom recycled PET apparel like the RPET Boonie Hat or the Men's Radius Quilted Vest gives your brand a tangible environmental story. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a polished, professional look that aligns with your green initiatives.
